project.name: osgi/domains/bbox
project.description: The bbox domain: the contact toward the Bouygues Bbox router (DHCP reservation reconciliation). bbox-port declares the neutral reconcile verb over a home vocabulary (no java-bbox-api-client type crosses the seam); bbox-edge is the @Component that embeds the client (like dbus-systemd embeds dbus-java) and translates home↔library. The host keeps the orchestration (blueprint enumeration, the Pulumi resource graph) and composes the contact from the registry.
